purpose: Teach: 戦隊/唐辛子/車いす/垣根/熱海/ウェディング/アロハ/ミント

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが戦隊もののDVD買ってくれたんだって?
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought you that sentai tokusatsu DVD, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, curious inflection. Gentle tease in the rise at the end. Leaning in slightly, genuinely interested in what matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、唐辛子のお菓子は辛くて食べられないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, those spicy chili crackers are too hot for me — I can't eat them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no complaint. Small, honest admission. The clarity of a child who knows what he can and cannot do. No shame in it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おじいちゃんが車いすで散歩に行かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandpa's been going out for walks in his wheelchair now.
lines.style: Soft observation, noting something significant without fanfare. A gentle notice of change. Quiet warmth underneath — she's watching out for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お庭の垣根に小鳥が止まっていたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there was a little bird sitting on the hedge in the garden!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. The delight of noticing something small and real. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. He wants to share this with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと熱海の温泉行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I'd really love to go to an onsen in Atami with your dad sometime.
lines.style: Wistful, almost dreamy. A soft wish spoken aloud. Slow, unhurried. She's thinking of something tender just beyond reach.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのウェディング楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really looking forward to your wedding!
lines.style: Pure, unguarded delight. No irony, no performance. The simple joy of anticipation. Open, bright, and completely sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがハワイ土産でアロハシャツくれたわよね
lines.en: Sho, remember when Mei-sis brought you back that aloha shirt from Hawaii?
lines.style: Warmth with a smile in the voice. Gentle recall of a gift given. Slightly pleased with herself for having done something he liked. Easy, nostalgic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ミントアイス大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, mint ice cream is my absolute favorite!
lines.style: Unguarded joy at something simple and true. A small definitive statement. Pure, direct warmth. The comfortable closing of a conversation with someone he trusts.
